name: Pronated front lat pulldown
definition: Sit under a high pulley with thighs restrained and hands pronated on a wide bar. Pull the bar down in front of the face toward the upper chest, then return overhead.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.movement: Pull the bar down in front of the face toward the upper chest, then return overhead.
value.finish: Finish with arms overhead and the same seated support.
value.range_of_motion: Record grip width, seat/thigh settings and the front-of-body lower endpoint.
